items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: He came over here when we did for George Wein the big festival at the Avery Fisher Hall on Lincoln Center.

ctx.x: Yeah. He came over here when we did for George Wein the big festival at the Avery Fisher Hall on Lincoln Center. He made all the announcements for the orchestra. There was an orchestra you know. My daughter danced. But when he said that to me I said, no. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
It’s a misunderstanding. You express the experiences of your life but you don’t have to be on drugs.
